response.justification: Deeply experienced full-stack engineer (15+ years, well beyond the 6+ requirement) with directly relevant recent work in TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS and Kubernetes, plus current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure work (MCP code generators, agentic frameworks) that maps precisely to the stated AI agent development requirement. Strong testing culture is evident from TDD practice, a self-authored test runner and assertion library, and testing workshops/courses. Gaps are mostly in specific named tools (Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, Playwright) and recency of Kotlin/Java, but these are learnable given the demonstrated polyglot breadth. Worth an interview with probing on backend architecture depth at scale and framework-specific ramp-up.
strengths: Core stack match: TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS, Docker/Kubernetes
Current AI-agent and MCP tooling experience — a hard-to-find requirement
Strong testing/craftsmanship track record (TDD, CI/CD, built own test tooling, teaches workshops)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, or Playwright experience listed
Kotlin absent and Java experience is dated (pre-2018); Python not mentioned
Significant focus on niche DLang ecosystem may signal tool preference over team-standard stacks

key_factors.factor: Primary stack + years of full-stack experience
Missing Nest.js, Vitest, and current Kotlin/Java
